values.note: Reservations by phone to the campground manager (850-256-5555) or by email to camping@myescambia.com; there is no online booking.

booking.source: https://myescambia.com/our-services/parks-and-recreation/lake-stone-campground ('For further details and reservations, please email Lake Stone or call the Campground Manager at 850-256-5555'; mailto:camping@myescambia.com), read 2026-10-21

note: Escambia County lakeside campground on Lake Stone near Century; boat ramp (no gasoline motors on the lake) and fishing pier; pay at the office, cash only; waterfront sites 14-night max. --Claude
summary: County page confirms 77 sites, water and electric hookups, showers, dump station, $18/day resident and $20.25 non-resident. Changed booking reservable false -> true (platform phone): the county takes reservations by phone or email. Amperage, max rig length, fcfs and the 14-night max not stated (derived values left). Note trimmed of the FCFS claim, the dump-station count and what the fields and rating carry.
flags: Fees: nightly_high 20.25 is the NON-resident rate ('Non-Escambia County residents: $20.25/day'), not a resident high; the resident base is a flat $18/day, so the stored range reads as $18-20.25 for everyone. Suggest nightly_low/high 18 with fees.nonresident {type: surcharge, amount: 2.25, per: night}. Left alone because the fees group is human-checked (2026-10-15). The county page also says 'The following rates were set as of April 1, 2021' — it is the current published table (page (c) 2026), but the rate's own date is 2021.
